fields.finding: One percent is an engineering allowance, not the manufacturer's moisture datum. The 84-case 3.5% finite-release sensitivity changes no payloads and has no pressure failure through 30 days; maximum 776.2574324310921 Pa.

qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration.
